posts.title: Chatting Over DNS
posts.description: It’s always fun to see how a tool can be used to do something that is not its primary purpose. Earlier this year I was playing around with the idea of developing an app that uses DNS for transferring data. I know what you’re thinking, “Isn’t DNS for figuring out the IP address of a domain?” Yeah, exactly that. DNS is one of the parts of the internet that works even in the most restricted networks.
